title: Peredur's Happy Jam Smiles
markdown:
Once upon a time, in a sunny meadow, lived Peredur the baker. His little bakery, under a big old tree, always smelled like warm bread and yummy berries. Every day, Peredur mixed dough and filled soft buns with sweet strawberry jam. He loved to bake, but his jam piping was always wiggly and uneven.

Then, one day, a special picnic was planned! Peredur wanted his jam buns to be the very best. He tried extra hard to pipe neat, straight lines. The buns looked tidy, but Peredur wished they were more special.

Just then, a bright rainbow butterfly fluttered past. Peredur paused, watching it dip and lift, and his paws wiggled just a little. The jam plopped onto a bun, making a happy, smiley face!

When his friends Milo the donkey and Tess the seal arrived, they giggled. “Look at that one!” said Tess. “It’s the happiest bun ever!” Milo nudged the smiley bun. “It looks like it’s laughing with jam!” Miss Clover the tortoise nodded wisely. “Sometimes,” she said, “the most wonderful things just… happen.”

Peredur saw his friends’ big smiles. The wobbly jam blob made everyone giggle with joy! He knew that perfect wasn’t always the most fun. Peredur picked up his piping bag, gave it a playful wiggle, and piped smiley faces onto all his buns.

Ever since then, Peredur’s bakery had the most wonderfully happy buns, each with a cheerful jam smile, making everyone in the meadow smile too.
characters: Peredur (a baker), Milo (a donkey), Tess (a seal)
